sections.heading: Streaming Details
paragraphs: According to Men's Journal, the fourth season of 'Reacher' has a specific release schedule. The source indicates that episodes will be released on Prime Video.

sections.heading: Cast Insights
paragraphs: Yahoo Entertainment reports that Alan Ritchson has shared a spoiler regarding the fourth season. The article suggests that while the actor is excited, readers of the book series may already anticipate the development.

sections.heading: Related Media
paragraphs: IMDb notes that a sequel to the film starring Tom Cruise is joining streaming platforms. This news arrives ahead of Alan Ritchson's return to the character.

faq.q: Where will the new season be available?
faq.a: Men's Journal reports that episodes will drop on Prime Video.

faq.q: Did Alan Ritchson comment on the new season?
faq.a: According to Yahoo, Alan Ritchson dropped a spoiler about the fourth season that he is excited about.
